note: 2.0.143: shanjian template picking rework + contacts 群发 fix + WhatsApp dependency false alarm fix. Templates now have 场景 chips (资讯混剪 / 真人模板 / 数字人模板) that drive both the list request and the submit scene, plus two locally derived tag rows read from the template name - 色系 and 风格 - each chip showing how many templates it matches, OR inside a group, AND across groups and with the keyword search. The 支持正文/不含正文 filter and the per-card layer chips are gone (production measured 110/110 templates across the three scenes carry all five layers, so they had no discriminating power, and body text is not a template property). Contacts bulk send now splits recipients into batches of 100 (the API caps a single request at 100 and answered 422, which the UI showed as 请求失败) with progress and a per-batch summary, one failed batch no longer stops the rest, and FastAPI validation errors render as readable text. WhatsApp status no longer claims 缺少依赖：pywinauto on machines where everything is installed - the dependency report never probed pywinauto, so WHATSAPP_REQUIRED_MODULES always counted it missing (and the 3-hourly auto-repair fired for nothing).
